test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

D _ _ S H T _ _ R I S H _ _ D R I _ _ T I D R I S _ _ .
solution:
Given :- D _ _ S H T _ _ R I S H _ _ D R I _ _ T I D R I S _ _ .

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) RDIITISHHT → D **R D** S H T **I - I** R I S H **T I** - D R I **S H** T I - D R I S **H T.**

2) RDIISHTIHT → D **R D** S H T **I - I** R I S H **S H** - D R I **T I** T I - D R I S **H T.**

**3) RIIDTISHHT → **D **R I** S H T **I - D** R I S H **T I - **D R I **S H** T I - D R I S **H T.**

4) RITIDTSHHT → D **R I** S H T **T - I** R I S H **D T** - D R I **S H **T I - D R I S **HT**

 
• Option (3) gives the pattern of **D R I S H T I** - D R I S H T I - **D R I S H T I** - D R I S H T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"RIIDTISHHT".**
